ITEM 3.D Risk Factors
Our business is subject to currency, supply chain, cybersecurity, and regulatory risks. These risk factors are broad descriptions and should be read with the operating data and financial statements below.
ITEM 4. Information on the Company
Global Fiber Limited designs network equipment and optical fiber systems for enterprise and telecommunications customers. During fiscal 2025 we launched a new product platform for edge routing customers in Asia and Europe.
ITEM 5. Operating and Financial Review and Prospects
Revenue increased by 8.2% to $1,420.0 million from $1,312.0 million due to higher enterprise demand. Net income was $110.0 million compared with $94.0 million in the prior fiscal year. Cash and cash equivalents 310.0 275.0. Total assets 2,900.0 2,700.0. Total liabilities 1,120.0 1,060.0.

ITEM 16I. Disclosure Regarding Foreign Jurisdictions that Prevent Inspections
The company is not owned or controlled by a governmental entity in a foreign jurisdiction. The auditor is registered with the PCAOB and was subject to PCAOB inspection during the period covered by this annual report.
